as_told.title: Visit to a New Mexico crash retrieval site with Tyler and Gary Nolan

tellings.quote: It should be noted here that in the beginning of the book I take a trip with Tyler, and James, another scientist, to New Mexico to an alleged UFO crash site.

plain: In 2016 the writer Diana Pasulka went with two men to a place in New Mexico where a UFO is said to have crashed and been recovered, a so-called crash retrieval site, and the trip opens her book American Cosmic, where she gave her companions pseudonyms. She tells Michels about it as her own experience, and says one of them, a scientist, was Garry Nolan, who "has come out" publicly since. In an interview about the book published in December 2018 she wrote that she took "a trip with Tyler, and James, another scientist, to New Mexico to an alleged UFO crash site." So in print the site is only "alleged" and the scientist is only "James", and the idea that James is Nolan rests on what she said later on the show.

discussion.by: INTERVIEW: D.W Pasulka brings 'American Cosmic' to the UFO forefront
discussion.text: In this 2018 interview Pasulka writes that "in the beginning of the book I take a trip with Tyler, and James, another scientist, to New Mexico to an alleged UFO crash site"; the site is "alleged" in her words here, a hedge the tellings of a crash retrieval site leave out. That "James" is Garry Nolan rests on her later spoken telling, not on this interview.
